description: Using the HR system, list active employees (termination_date IS NULL) who earn strictly more than their direct manager. Employees without a manager (manager_id IS NULL) are never returned. The manager's own employment status does not matter. Output columns: employee_id (INT64), employee_name (STRING), department_name (STRING), salary (NUMERIC), manager_name (STRING), manager_salary (NUMERIC). Sort by employee_id.

manager_id.description: Self-reference to employees.employee_id; NULL for top-level

department_id.description: Foreign key to departments; may be NULL for contractors

edge_cases: Top-level employee with NULL manager_id is excluded
Terminated employee earning more than the manager is excluded
Employee with NULL department_id must still be returned with department_name NULL
common_failure_modes: FM1: Joining on e.employee_id = m.manager_id (reversed direction) lists managers instead of reports
FM1: INNER JOIN to departments drops employees with NULL department_id
